messages:
maria: hey @oncall, canary-3 (us-east-1) just spiked 5xx across the board. not seeing the usual canary panel in the release dashboard, looks like the tile is missing :confused:

incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service-redwood-inference - 5xx-rate > 3% for 2m (canary-3) - page sent to @oncall - incident_id=INC-2169

dan: i'm taking this. can anyone confirm whether the canary isolation tag is being passed to metrics? queries are returning global aggregates only

sre_lead: quick check — are we on the new telemetry pipeline pruning? last deploy touched metric tag enrichment. if tag missing, SLO burn won't attribute to canary and pager will be noisy.

maria: yeah the deploy included a small agent change, might've toggled tag enrichment. i can't find the canary-specific dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/abc123/release-overview - that panel is gone for me

carla: running log tail and sending sample errors:
```
2026-03-15T14:10:12Z service=redwood-inference request_id=abcd status=502 canary=canary-3 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T14:10:13Z service=redwood-inference request_id=abce status=504 canary=canary-3 route=/v1/generate
```

dan: ok errors look real and concentrated in canary-3. but pager shows global SLO burn which is confusing to platform oncall. we need a quick mitigation path.

sre_lead: immediate plan: 1) flip kill switch for the feature flag for this rollout 2) rollback canary if kill doesn't stop error 3) restore metric tags and re-evaluate before unblocking rollout. who's on infra to flip the flag?

carla: i can flip the flag. flag name is ff/release-291. command below:
```bash
# toggle off
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KF_TOKEN" 
  https://flags.redwood.prod/api/v1/flags/ff%2Frelease-291/toggle -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

carla: done — turned ff/release-291 -> false at 2026-03-15T14:12:05Z

maria: seeing immediate drop in traffic to canary-3 pods but still seeing error traces in last 30s. is the kill switching traffic or just disabling new connections?

dan: it's disabling the feature path, but existing inflight requests might keep failing for a bit. i'm rolling the canary back from the dashboard now (canary-3 -> scale to 0).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: ACTION: feature flag ff/release-291 toggled off by carla. ACTION: canary-3 scaled to 0 by dan.

sre_lead: good. next — observability followup: we have two issues here: (a) the metric enrichment task lost the canary tag after the agent change, (b) the release dashboard removed the canary panel during a panel refactor. both allowed the alert to surface as a global SLO burn and made routing ambiguous.

ben: i'll take the postmortem on the dashboard panel change. assigning owner and adding to the release checklist so this panel can't be removed without a QA guard.

maria: i'll pair with platform telemetry to add a smoke check in the deploy pipeline: verify canary tag shows up in metrics within 5m of agent rollout.

carla: current customer impact: we saw a small burst of 502/504 for <6 minutes, affecting ~0.4% of requests globally but concentrated entirely on customers routed to canary-3. No Sev1 reports yet from key customers. I'll update support with list of affected deployments.

dan: oncall handoff for the next shift: ben, i'll leave you with the running checks i set up:
```bash
# canary tag check (run every 1m)
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood.prod/api/query?expr=sum(rate(requests_total{canary=~\"canary-.*\"}[2m])) by (canary)" | jq '.'
```
Check: canary-3 should be zero after scale-down. If we see >0.1 rps, escalate to infra.

ben: got it, taking over. summary for next oncall:
- incident_id=INC-2169
- root cause: agent deploy removed/enabled metric tag enrichment -> canary tag missing from metrics + dashboard panel refactor removed canary tile -> alerting attributed globally -> noisy pager
- mitigations: ff/release-291 toggled off, canary-3 scaled to 0, monitoring checks in place
- customer impact: <6m of elevated 5xx for canary traffic (~0.4% global)
- next steps: restore metric enrichment, re-add canary panel, add pre-deploy smoke validations, update runbook

incident-bot: :memo: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2169 - mitigated -> monitoring. next update in 30m or on status change.

maria: thanks all. assigning follow-ups: telemetry fix -> maria, dashboard guard -> ben, runbook + smoke -> dan.

ben: acknowledged. i'll keep an eye through the next 2h and will reopen page if regression occurs. :thumbsup:
